question: Should experimental Claws adopt YAML-frontmatter `CLAW.md` as the canonical authored and exported manifest while continuing to accept the existing grouped JSON input?
rationale: This sets the durable package entrypoint and export representation for an unmerged, compatibility-sensitive experimental lifecycle; tests alone cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Confirm the CLAW.md contract
options.body: Sponsor the proposed canonical `CLAW.md` artifact, provided the contributor supplies current-head lifecycle proof and the parent stack lands first.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Retain grouped JSON as the canonical export format and treat Markdown authoring as a future, separately sponsored format adapter.

options.title: Pause the format layer
options.body: Defer this stack stage until maintainers resolve the broader Claws lifecycle and package-distribution direction.

recommendation.title: Confirm the CLAW.md contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor the proposed canonical `CLAW.md` artifact, provided the contributor supplies current-head lifecycle proof and the parent stack lands first.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed feature-history contact across the current and predecessor Claws stack; final product approval remains a repository maintainer decision.
